claude delegate remote cancel.attempts: The cancelled task's result is steered into the parent's running Claude turn on both servers, and this fixture's CLI never reads it before its turn ends. A steering difference of its own, not of tasks in linked environments; the task, its result, its cancel and every call to the linked environment match.
